notes.edges: imports = value edges (static import, export-from, side-effect import, dynamic import(), require(), new URL(./x, import.meta.url) runtime refs). typeImports = edges where every specifier is type-only (import type / export type / all-`type` named specifiers / import("x").T type nodes) and no value edge to the same file exists.
notes.orphan: orphan = non-test file not reachable from any entry by value imports. orphanKind: type-only (reachable only through type imports), test-only (only tests import it), unreachable.
notes.layers: Topological depth over value+type edges among non-test files, after collapsing cycles (SCCs). Layer 0 = no internal dependencies.
notes.processes: api / bot / cron / script, derived from reachableFrom (value edges).

crates.name: dima-ai
crates.description: LLM clients (OpenRouter, MiniMax, embeddings), Qdrant, AI memory, clip recommendations.

crates.name: dima-analytics
crates.description: Stream sessions/analytics/timeline, site analytics, raid analytics, follow ledger.

crates.name: dima-api
crates.description: BINARY api: HTTP server bootstrap, routes, OAuth routes.

crates.name: dima-billing
crates.description: Plans, Polar.sh, credits, AI usage ledger/receipts, referrals.

crates.name: dima-bot
crates.description: BINARY bot: bot process entry and its EventSub websocket client.

crates.name: dima-chat
crates.description: Built-in chat commands and Twitch chat/EventSub handlers (bot logic; today also reachable from the API).

crates.name: dima-commands
crates.description: Command model below the engine: command/cooldown classes, permissions/roles, availability, timers policy, chat moderation rules.

crates.name: dima-core
crates.description: Logger, env, crypto, URL builders, DB connections (Mongo, Dragonfly), telemetry/metrics. No domain logic.

crates.name: dima-cron
crates.description: BINARY cron: supervisor, native Rust index bridge, every worker entry and cron-only helpers.

crates.name: dima-email
crates.description: Transactional email service and templates (React Email in TS today).

crates.name: dima-engine
crates.description: Command engine: AST tokenizer/parser/evaluator, function registry, AI tools + OpenRouter chat, chat delivery, follow defense (the 61-file cycle and what only it uses).

crates.name: dima-event-handlers
crates.description: Domain event consumers: registry, consumer runtime and the per-feature event mappers (they call every feature).

crates.name: dima-events
crates.description: Domain event runtime: contracts, identity, producers, store, wakeups, durable cron-job intents.

crates.name: dima-model
crates.description: Mongo schemas/document types plus the small pure types and constants the schemas and contracts depend on.

crates.name: dima-platform
crates.description: Shared server-side services that realtime and the API both call: OAuth catalog/service, HTTP auth middleware, pet settings, media library, TTS usage.

crates.name: dima-realtime
crates.description: Overlays, widgets, widget feed, pets, goals, duel, roulette, DimaFX, websocket hub, media/TTS queues.

crates.name: dima-scripts
crates.description: BINARIES: one-off CLI scripts (migrations, backfills, smoke tests).

crates.name: dima-services
crates.description: API-side services (AI personality, command blocks/mutations, EventSub config, moderation/TTS settings, overlay services) and API-only helpers.

crates.name: dima-site-agent
crates.description: Dashboard site agent and docs assistant (LLM tool runners, docs index, write tools).

crates.name: dima-tts
crates.description: TTS text normalisation, voices, providers (Fish, Kokoro, Piper).

crates.name: dima-twitch
crates.description: Twitch auth/tokens, streamer cache, Helix client wrappers (functions/**), EventSub subscription management.
